intended_objectives: Approach the loose center ball while the two opponents move toward the crossing band.
Recover stamina and align the teammate west of the holder.
Attempt a physical pass and catch, then an adjacent opponent tackle. These are predicted events, not an observed trajectory.
legality_basis: All in-range actions are legal attempts while live, including blocked movement and unmet interaction conditions. Stop at done_all; after that only no-op 0 is legal.
